item.title: Jimm's Steakhouse & Pub announces death of their own, promises to go extra this Christmas

item.title: See-saw temperatures before an arctic bully weighs temperatures down on Sunday
item.description: Temperatures will continue to fluctuate throughout the week, with a cold front arriving Friday and an arctic air mass bringing temperatures to their lowest levels of the season by Sunday morning, before milder temperatures return on Monday.

item.title: Could we see a White Christmas this year? Breaking down the unlikely chances
item.description: It’s been awhile since the Ozarks have woken up to that classic postcard scene on Christmas morning. In fact, since 1990, we’ve only logged two official white Christmases. The most recent came in 2022, when a winter storm swept through just days before the holiday. Temperatures stayed cold enough that the snow never fully melted, [...]

item.title: Springfield’s forgotten UFO? The bizarre 1897 airship seen over Missouri
item.description: SPRINGFIELD, Mo. — In the spring of 1897, residents across southwest Missouri described sightings of a mysterious “airship” — a craft they said resembled a giant mechanical dragonfly and appeared to drift silently over trains, towns and backyards. This was years before the first powered airplane was invented. The reports, published in the Springfield Weekly [...]

item.title: Two dead after car crash in Dent County
item.description: Two people, including an infant, were killed and two others were seriously injured in a crash in Dent County, Missouri on Wednesday morning.

item.title: Missouri State Highway Patrol trooper charged with rape in Howell County
item.description: Ethan Hinge, a trooper with the Missouri State Highway Patrol, was arrested and charged with second-degree rape after a woman accused him of sexually assaulting her in July, to which he pleaded not guilty and was placed on administrative leave.
